Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the expiration of the agency council on coordinated transportation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to extending the expiration of the agency councilon coordinated transportation; amending RCW 47.06B.900 and 47.06B.901;providing an effective date; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.06B.900 and 2009 c 515 s 17 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The agency council on coordinated transportation is terminated onJune 30, ((2011, as provided in RCW 47.06B.901)) 2013.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.06B.901 and 2009 c 515 s 18 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts, as now existing or hereafteramended, are each repealed, effective June 30, ((2012)) 2014: (1) RCW 47.06B.010 and 2009 c 515 s 3, 2007 c 421 s 1, 1999 c 385s 1, & 1998 c 173 s 1; (2) RCW 47.06B.012 and 1999 c 385 s 2; (3) RCW 47.06B.020 and 2009 c 515 s 4, 2007 c 421 s 2, & 1998 c 173s 2; p. 1 SHB 1979 (4) RCW 47.06B.030 and ((2009 c 515 s 5,)) 2007 c 421 s 3, 1999 c385 s 5, & 1998 c 173 s 3; (5) RCW 47.06B.040 and 2007 c 421 s 4 & 1999 c 385 s 6; (6) RCW 47.06B.050 and 2009 c 515 s 8 & 2007 c 421 s 6; (7) RCW 47.06B.060 and 2009 c 515 s 1; (8) ((Section 2 of this act; (9) Section 6 of this act; (10) Section 7 of this act; (11))) RCW 47.06B.070 and 2009 c 515 s 9; (((12))) (9) RCW 47.06B.075 and 2009 c 515 s 10; and (((13))) (10) RCW 47.06B.080 and 2009 c 515 s 11.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJune 30, 2011.
